 Realme 11.11 sale: Up to 55% off, smartphones from RM499 and RM11 deals
 BY 
 Alexander Wong 
 5 November 2026 
 11:29 pm 
 Comment 
 Share on Facebook Share on Twitter 
 If you’re planning to upgrade your smartphone or get some new tech accessories, Realme Malaysia has announced its 11.11 Double Digit Sale with discounts of up to 55% across Shopee ,  Lazada and  TikTok Shop .
 Besides discounted smartphones from as low as RM499, Realme is also offering selected tablets, smartwatches and accessories for just RM11 and RM111. There are also additional platform vouchers, free shipping offers and complimentary gifts with selected purchases.
 Similar to its previous 10.10 sale, Realme is offering different deals across the three eCommerce platforms. Here’s a breakdown of what you can expect.
 Realme Shopee 11.11 deals (8-11 November 2026)
 Realme’s Shopee 11.11 Big Sale runs from 8 to 11 November 2026, offering up to 18% Shopee cashback and free shipping vouchers.
 Here are the featured smartphone deals:
 Realme P4x (4GB + 256GB)  – RM729 (RRP: RM899)
 Realme 16 Pro+ 5G (12GB + 512GB)  – RM2,391 (RRP: RM2,699). Includes a free smart band and TechLife Buds worth RM198.
 Realme C100i (4GB + 128GB)  – RM597 (RRP: RM799)
 Besides smartphones, Realme is offering several limited-time deals for as low as RM11 and RM111:
 Realme Pad 2 (6GB + 128GB)  – RM111 (RRP: RM1,299)
 Realme Air 7 Pro  – RM111 (RRP: RM399)
 Realme Watch S2 Limited Edition  – RM111 (RRP: RM599)
 Realme Magnetic Cooling Clip  – RM11 (RRP: RM149)
 The RM11 and RM111 deals are available in limited quantities and for a limited time only.
 Realme Lazada 11.11 deals (7-11 November 2026)
 Over on Lazada, Realme’s 11.11 Biggest Sale kicks off at 8:00 PM on 7 November and runs until 11 November 2026.
 The campaign offers discounts of up to 40%, additional platform vouchers of up to 8% and free shipping vouchers.
 Here are the featured Lazada smartphone deals:
 Realme P4 Power 5G (12GB + 256GB)  – RM1,799 (RRP: RM1,999)
 Realme 16 Pro 5G (12GB + 512GB)  – RM2,099 (RRP: RM2,299). Includes a free 45W Cabled Power Bank worth RM199.
 Realme C100 5G (4GB + 128GB)  – RM899 (RRP: RM999). Includes free TechLife Buds worth RM99.
 Realme TikTok Shop 11.11 deals (1-11 November 2026)
 Meanwhile, Realme’s TikTok Shop 11.11 Mega Syok Sale runs from 1 to 11 November 2026, offering discounts of up to 55% and free shipping vouchers.
 Here are the featured smartphone deals:
 Realme P4 Lite  – RM499 (RRP: RM699)
 Realme Note 80 (4GB + 128GB)  – RM579 (RRP: RM699)
 Realme C100x  – RM899 (RRP: RM999)
 TikTok Shop is also running RM11 and RM111 deals on selected tablets and accessories:
 Realme Pad 2 Lite (4GB + 128GB)  – RM111 (RRP: RM899)
 Realme Watch S2  – RM111 (RRP: RM499)
 Realme 100W Double-Ended USB-C Cable  – RM11 (RRP: RM49.90)
 Do note that the RM11 and RM111 offers are limited-time deals with limited quantities available.
 All promotional prices listed are after applicable vouchers and are subject to stock availability. Since Realme is offering different promotions across Shopee, Lazada and TikTok Shop, it is worth comparing the final checkout prices before making a purchase.
